tag: 國際機械博覽會參展廠商佈展須知廣播

level.why: 廣播含原因與結果子句、被動語態及條件限制，需整合裝卸時間、安全檢查、退款領取與撤展期限；字彙偏抽象（mandate、vacate），干擾項取自文中相近的時間點與規定。

passage: Good afternoon, exhibitors, and welcome to the Harbor City Machinery Expo. I would like to go over several important points about setup. First, the loading dock opens at seven tomorrow morning, and all crates must be unloaded before ten, because the hall will then be cleared for the opening ceremony. Second, local fire rules mandate that every power cord be placed under a protective cover, and any booth that fails the inspection will be shut down until the problem is corrected. Please have the executive in charge of your booth present during that inspection. Third, early registration rebates will be issued immediately upon arrival at the information desk, so please bring your confirmation number. Finally, all booths must be vacated by six on Sunday evening. If a messenger will be delivering materials on your behalf, please give us the name in advance. Thank you, and enjoy the expo.
zh: 各位參展廠商午安，歡迎來到港城機械博覽會。我想先說明幾項重要的佈展事項。第一，裝卸碼頭明天早上七點開放，所有木箱都必須在十點前卸下，因為屆時展場會清場，準備開幕典禮。第二，當地消防規定要求每一條電源線都必須放在保護蓋下方，任何未通過檢查的攤位，在問題改善前都會被停止營業。請讓負責該攤位的主管在檢查時到場。第三，早鳥報名退款將在抵達服務台時立即發放，所以請攜帶您的確認編號。最後，所有攤位都必須在週日晚上六點前騰空。如果有快遞員要代表您送來資料，請事先告知我們姓名。謝謝大家，祝各位博覽會順利愉快。

vocab.col: unload a truck / unload the cargo
vacate the premises / vacate a room
a messenger service / hire a messenger

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the announcement?
opts: To advertise a new line of machinery
To give exhibitors instructions for setting up their booths
To announce changes to the opening ceremony schedule
To thank visitors for attending the expo
why: 錯誤：公告並非在宣傳機械產品。
正解：公告說明裝卸、檢查、退款與撤展等佈展相關事項。
錯誤：開幕典禮只是說明清場時間的背景。
錯誤：對象是參展廠商，不是參觀者。

questions.q: By what time must all crates be unloaded?
opts: The start of the opening ceremony
why: 錯誤：七點是裝卸碼頭開放時間。
錯誤：週日晚上六點是撤展截止時間。
正解：所有木箱必須在十點前卸下。
錯誤：十點之後展場清場以準備開幕，並非以典禮開始為截止。

questions.q: What will happen to a booth that fails the power cord inspection?
opts: It will be shut down until the problem is fixed
It will lose its early registration rebate
It will be moved to a different hall
It will be fined on Sunday evening
why: 正解：未通過檢查的攤位在問題改善前會被停止營業。
錯誤：退款與檢查結果無關，是憑確認編號領取。
錯誤：文中沒有提到更換展廳。
錯誤：週日晚上六點是撤展時間，與罰款無關。

questions.q: Visitors are advised to arrive early ______ they can avoid long lines at the entrance.
why: 錯誤：as if 表示「好像」，語意不符。
錯誤：in case of 後接名詞，不接子句。
錯誤：owing to 後接名詞，不接子句。
正解：so that 引導目的子句，表示「以便」。

questions.q: Booth rental fees are non-refundable ______ the event is canceled by the organizers.
why: 正解：unless 表示「除非」，語意為除非活動被主辦方取消。
錯誤：while 表示同時，語意不通。
錯誤：although 表示讓步，語意不符。
錯誤：because 表示原因，語意不符。

questions.q: All exhibitors are ______ to remove their displays by the end of the final day.
why: 錯誤：requiring 為現在分詞，與 are 組成的被動語態不符。
錯誤：requirement 為名詞，無法接 to 不定詞。
正解：are required to 為被動語態，意為「被要求」。
錯誤：require 為原形動詞，不能接在 are 之後。
